description: Election Commission - Mr. Joseph silvester of the Walapane Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of Member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Walapane Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government member status, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) as it deals with the composition of an elected local authority body under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
